statement: A deterministic production-seam discriminator emits a measured classification for normal exact-generation operation-ledger REPLACE completion, lost or late response after target leadership, leadership before local PARTITIONS hydration, and independent ACTIVE, STOPPING, terminal-persistence, and visibility-confirmation failure, while stale, wrong-generation, demoted, and no-quorum evidence cannot release canonical remove safety and runtime policy remains unchanged.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

This investigative Quest may add deterministic fixtures, scenario adapters, and immutable evidence only; it must not change runtime policy, admission, retry, timeout, lease, membership, quorum, remove-safety, or operation-ledger semantics.

A target-handoff response, target-only self-report, or transport acknowledgement is not physical leadership proof; each applicable case must assert the exact replacement generation, leader identity, and finite term from the target plus voting-majority agreement on that leader and term before evaluating continuation or terminality.

Response loss or lateness, leader transition before local PARTITIONS-row hydration, and ACTIVE or STOPPING or terminal persistence and visibility-confirmation failure must be injected and classified independently, alongside a normal baseline.

Wrong generation, stale prior leader, demoted target, absent quorum, transport acknowledgement without processing evidence, and failed authoritative terminal persistence must never authorize source removal or release the serialized ledger hold.

The discriminator must exercise the existing workflow owner, partition metadata publication owner, canonical remove-safety owner, local-deferred progress, terminal-transition repair, and ledger interlock; it must not introduce a second cache, workflow engine, completion authority, or gate-local Raft decision.
All evidence must name a clean source fingerprint based on commit 54b672c441ad5d1bb1cd79a9d35766bd8568dae2, which contains checkpoint 57bad436; the mixed main worktree is not a valid test baseline.
